candidates.claim: OT-facing port GigabitEthernet1/0/6 on sw-ot-01 is an active access port in VLAN 30 instead of VLAN 10, which the registry requires for all OT-facing ports.
candidates.remediation: Set the access VLAN of GigabitEthernet1/0/6 on sw-ot-01 back to VLAN 10 unless the VLAN 30 assignment is an approved change.

candidates.claim: Interface GigabitEthernet1/0/6 on sw-ot-01 deviates from the approved baseline: switchport access vlan changed from 10 to 30.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this deviation by reverting the access VLAN to 10 or recording the change as approved in the baseline.

clarifications.question: rtr-01 has a management interface GigabitEthernet0 at 10.10.99.12/24 in MGMT and two default routes (via 198.51.100.1 and via 10.10.99.1), while its Gi0/0/0 OUTSIDE interface has EDGE_IN. Can traffic arriving from OUTSIDE reach MGMT through rtr-01 without passing fw-01, and is that routing intended?

fw-01 has the ASA HTTP server enabled (fw-01:109), and rtr-01 EDGE_IN permits TCP and UDP 443 from any source to 203.0.113.2, the fw-01 outside address. The snapshot has no mgmt_access record for the outside interface. Is HTTPS/ASDM reachable on the fw-01 outside interface, and if so, is that permitted by the management policy?
